mechanism.notes: J2 replaced by a spherical four-bar on link 1 whose coupler carries J3 and turns about a virtual pole. bodies: link 1 (carries the ground pins A0, B0), crank A, crank B, coupler (carries the J3 hub), arm-end (hub-3 plate + K7 neck). joints: J1, J3 O20 hubs, A0 (ACTIVE, the J2 drive), B0, A1, B1 (PASSIVE); 1 loop (the four-bar; spherical Grubler 3 (6 - 1) - 2 x 6 = 3). Passives set by the crank angle: not sensed. Default slim = 0 (O20 pins). custom: base, link 1, 2 cranks, coupler, neck, 6 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 6 x MR117 pair (est.).
